step1_analysis.description: A modified four-quadrant multiplier architecture acting as an OTA with current division. It uses two differential pairs with separate tail currents and a current mirror to combine signals, designed for very low transconductance and low-frequency applications.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Transconductance Amplifier Architecture With Wide Tuning Range for Very Low Frequency Applications

sky130_expected.calculation: Av = Gm * Rout. Gm ~ 210 uA/V, Rout ~ 130 kOhm. Av ~ 27 V/V = 28.6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without cascodes in 130nm, intrinsic gain (gm*ro) is much lower than in older long-channel processes like 1.2um.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = Gm / (2*pi*CL). Gm ~ 210 uA/V, CL = 180 pF. GBW = 210u / (2*pi*180p) = 185 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact transconductance and the large 180pF load capacitance reported in the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at ~5 kHz, non-dominant pole at ~1.8 GHz. PM ~ 90 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The large load capacitance (180pF) pushes the dominant pole very low, ensuring excellent stability and a ~90 degree phase margin.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total = I_tail1 + I_tail2 + I_XM8 + I_bias = 38u + 38u + 57u + 38u = 171 uA. Power = 171uA * 1.8V = 308 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law current estimates for the given bias voltages in SKY130.

output_swing.description: Maximum and minimum output voltage levels

sky130_expected.calculation: Vmax = VDD - Vov_pmos = 1.8 - 0.3 = 1.5V. Vmin = VSS + Vov_nmos = 0 + 0.2 = 0.2V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the saturation voltage (Vdsat) of the output transistors XM1, XM4, XM7, XM8.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, GBW, phase margin, output voltage swing, and power consumption. An ideal DC CMFB loop is used to stabilize the high-impedance output node at 0.9V without affecting AC or Transient measurements.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for CMOS Transconductance Amplifier

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N_OUT VIP N_TAIL1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N_MIRROR VREF N_TAIL1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N_MIRROR VREF N_TAIL2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N_OUT VIN N_TAIL2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N_MIRROR N_MIRROR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N_MIRROR N_MIRROR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N_OUT N_MIRROR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N_OUT VCMFB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VB VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N_TAIL1 VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N_TAIL2 VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVREF VREF 0 0.9
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.5 1k 0 0)
VVIP VIP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
VVCMFB VCMFB 0 0.9
VVB VB 0 0.99

* Load Capacitance (180pF as reported in paper)
C_load N_OUT 0 180p

* Ideal DC CMFB to stabilize output operating point
* This loop forces N_OUT to 0.9V DC but is completely open for AC and Tran
E_err N_err 0 N_OUT 0.9 1
R_cmfb N_err N_err_f 1G
C_cmfb N_err_f 0 1
G_cmfb N_OUT 0 N_err_f 0 1m

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 0.1 100MEG
  let gain_db = vdb(N_OUT)
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(N_OUT))
  
  meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
  meas ac f3db when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase_deg when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis (large signal to measure swing and power)
  tran 10u 5m
  meas tran vout_max max v(N_OUT)
  meas tran vout_min min v(N_OUT)
  meas tran power_avg avg -i(VVDD)*1.8
  
  print dc_gain f3db gbw phase_at_gbw vout_max vout_min power_avg
  quit
.endc
.end
